text: Nope, not doing that. Like I said, I don't have an order ID. I just bought this T-Shirt, it's too big. I need to exchange it. This is the second time it's been wrong. Can I just talk to someone who can actually fix this?
zh: 不行，不这么办。就像我说的，我没有订单号。我刚刚买了这个T恤，它太大。我需要换货。这是第二次出错了。我能和能实际解决这个问题的人谈谈吗？
